feedback: Written before this candidate has raced; no outcome is claimed for it. Evidence from iteration 4 (y 0.07, 16 mm footprints, span ±0.024 m, kp 4.0, kd 0.5, score 534.0): the oval finished 20 of 20 with max_error 0.020 and oscillation 0.22, the s-bend finished 9 of 20 with 11 off-track exits and max_error 0.048, and slalom finished 0 of 20 with line_loss 1.0. Iteration 3 (y 0.04, score 131.9) and iteration 1 (y 0.06, score 454.6) show that lookahead gain is strong and monotone so far. Iteration 2 showed that widening the span to ±0.032 m with kp 4.5 hurt the oval, so keep the span and footprint. I am correcting my earlier advice: I previously suggested wheel_track 0.14 for more turn authority, and that was wrong. Yaw per PWM count is the wheel speed difference divided by wheel_track, so a narrower track adds yaw authority. Next race, if the s-bend off-track exits fall and max_error drops below 0.048 while the oval finish stays at 1.0 and oscillation stays below about 0.4, keep y 0.08 and try the first requested change to reduce s-bend control_effort. If oscillation rises above about 0.4 or the oval finish falls below 0.85, step back to y 0.07 (the best design so far) and try the second change. If slalom line_loss stays at about 1.0 with lookahead fixed, try the third change.
